steps.caption: Open Ask AI, then Saved commands.
Ready-made commands: morning briefing, priority accounts, meeting briefs, reports…
It's now in Your commands. Open it.
Edit its name, description, the question it asks, inputs and output format.
Saving an edit creates a new version, so earlier runs stay explained.
Schedule: 'Not scheduled' — it only runs when you press Run now.
Pick a time (IST) and days: Mon–Fri, every day or Mondays.
Explicit opt-in: tick 'I authorise…'. It only reads data and prepares drafts — nothing is sent.
Now it shows when it runs next and when you authorised it. The list marks it 'Scheduled'.
Run now any time — the result opens in Ask AI, and History lists each run.
